caption:
Remember Allah much, starting right now, mid-scroll.

Allah calls the believers to remember Him much and to glorify Him morning and evening. Pause here and remember Him before you move on.

— Surah Al-Ahzaab 33:41-42

Name one moment today when you'll stop to remember Him.

#dhikr #rememberallah #islamicreels #quranreels
alt_text: O you who believe, remember Allah much; and glorify Him morning and evening — Surah Al-Ahzaab 33:41-42
